title: Factor row-class cardinality over the prime-power components
statement: For each natural number m, let R_m=ℤ/mℤ and let P_m be the quotient of {(r,s)∈R_m² | ∃x,y∈R_m, xr+ys=1} by simultaneous multiplication by a unit of R_m. For every nonzero natural number N, let S be its finite set of prime divisors and e_p=N.factorization p. Then Nat.card P_N=∏_{p∈S} Nat.card P_(p^e_p).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], let P : ℕ → Type := fun n => Quot (fun v w : {v : ZMod (n) × ZMod (n) // ∃ x y : ZMod (n), x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1} => ∃ u : (ZMod (n))ˣ, (u : ZMod (n)) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : ZMod (n)) * v.1.2 = w.1.2); Nat.card (P N) = N.primeFactors.prod (fun p => Nat.card (P (p ^ N.factorization p)))
